About us

A club built on teamwork and play

The Mathematics Club of Bicol Regional Science High School (Schools Division Office of Ligao City, Region V) organizes activities that help students apply mathematical knowledge while developing logical and strategic thinking.

Its documented goals include fostering cooperation among members, raising funds for future projects, encouraging active participation in mathematics, and deepening the Brisayan spirit. The club also maintains the school’s Mathematics Laboratory as a place to store, display and borrow learning tools and as a venue for meetings and planning.

Programs & activities

What the club has been doing

Documented activities from the club’s accomplishment reports. Filter by category.

Sept 5, 2026

Cleaning of the Math Laboratory

Officers and members retrieved geometric models from classrooms, sorted usable and damaged games, and stored materials so the room is safe and accessible.

Sept 9, 2026

Brisayan Day Celebration

Eight booths — food, handmade products and four math games — ran during the 9:00 AM–1:30 PM bazaar.

Oct 16, 2026

Math Lab Clean-Up Drive

Members and Grade 10 students swept, dusted, arranged equipment and placed curtains in the laboratory.

Oct 2026

Bulletin Board Restoration

Outdated content was replaced with area and volume formulas, club events, and certificates and recognitions from math competitions. Budget ₱1,224; spent ₱1,145.

Numeracy Tools and Manipulatives

Students and teachers work with hands-on numeracy tools, including geoboards and rubber bands, in classroom and small-group sessions.

Oct 26, 2026

Big Bay Bei (BBB) Orientation

Facilitated by Ma’am Joemylene L. Sañosa at the BRSHS Gymnasium, covering guidelines, preparations and responsibilities for the BBB Mathematics Competition.

Nov 2026 meeting

Planning: BRSHS Nexus, Term 2

Proposed for Dec 10–11, 2026: Math Showcase, Quiz Bee, Amazing Race, Logo Making, E-Modulo, Rubik’s Cube Competition and more. Subject to approval.

Brisayan Day booths

Games

Four math games

Balance the Coin, Pop the Balloon (solve the equation inside), Memory Game (flip 1–10 in order) and “Salamin-Salamin.”

Food

Pancakes, fries & drinks

The club’s main source of income for the event.

Handmade

Bracelets, keychains, crochet

Custom bracelet making, personalized keychains and handmade crochet items.
